dungeon_ruin: the Sunken Cenote of the Shahs
epithet: of the Witz and the Garden

morphology.compounding_rule: Old-Persian quality/relation + element via the ezafe ([quality]-ahya [stem]: Arta-xshaca, truth-realm; Vazraka-paridaida, the great paradise) layered over Mayan [color|quality] + feature ([Chak-witz], red-pyramid): the capital Xochistan (the flower-realm), Paridak'uh-Xochi (the flowering garden), Noh-Witza-pura (the great pyramid-city).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Old-Persian ruling court keeps a house (vith-X) and the filiation 'X-ahya puthra' / 'X-puthmen' on the shifted god-stems and on Arta- (Truth); the Mayan populace keep the ch'ib'al (chibala) lineage with the aj-/ix- agentive and the calendar-day name; the throne fuses both - a Shah who also carries a witz-dynasty's ch'ib'al.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: vine-choked pyramids and dead fire-gardens: 'the lost Atawitza of [ajaw]', 'the buried Apadana of Dida-[name]', 'the Sunken Cenote of the Shahs', 'the dead Paridak'uh of [name]'
patterns.military_units: the [power] Spada (host) and the jungle warrior-companies: 'the Spada of Urlaspa', 'the Jaguar Holkan', 'the Flower-War Eagles'
patterns.ships: river-canoes and royal-road barges (a garden-and-jungle realm's few craft): 'Bearer of the Baji', 'the Jade Canoe', 'Boat of Arzanta', 'the Quetzal of the Rautah'
patterns.taverns: the balche'-and-wine garden-court: 'The Cacao House', 'The Golden Farnah', 'The Cup of Truth (Arta-jam)', 'The Flowering Bowl'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Old-Persian-shifted Axsatran morphs PRIMARY (the culture_axsatran shifted set: Turvasa, Urlaspa, Naumana, Arzanta, Asturna), Mayan Ixalan morphs SECONDARY (family_mesoamerican theonym_sets.mayan: Tulax, Orlanab, Numench, Marakab), never real Iranian/Zoroastrian or Maya gods (no Ahura Mazda, Mithra, Itzamna, Kukulkan, Chaac). Shared pantheon, two registers married. The cardinal virtue from the Persian backbone is ARTA (Truth/Right-order); its opposite is DRAUGA (the Lie); the king's word is bond. The realm fuses the paradaida walled-garden rite and the witz pyramid blood-rite into one cult of the flowering offering. Worship vs demonization follows the culture's CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment).

clergy_ladder.5: Magupati (chief magus of a fire-garden temple) / Ah-k'uhun (god-keeper)
clergy_ladder.9: Magupatan Magupat (chief of chief magi) / Ah-k'in Mai (high priest)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as the hosts of Drauga (the Lie) or as kisin (Mayan death-demons), keep their morphs + a hostile epithet: Maraxus -> Marakhsha the Burner-of-Cities (Mayan Marakab the War-Fire); Vacidus -> Vakida the Devouring-Void (Mayan Wakix the Devourer); Lusanto -> Lusanta the Coin-Serpent (Mayan Lusankaan the Hoard-Serpent).

holy_symbol_motifs.Riyata: the flowering moon-rabbit cradling maize in a watered paradaida-bowl
holy_symbol_motifs.Turvasa: a rayed sun above the upright Arta-measure set on the witz-pyramid step
holy_symbol_motifs.Urlaspa: an iron spear crossed with an oath-ring over the flower-war glyph

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Atawitza (the fire-altar pyramid) or the Paridak'uh (the sacred walled garden) of [power]: 'the Atawitza of Turvasa', 'the Paridak'uh of Riyata'; the magi keep the ever-burning Atar on the witz-altar amid the flowering garden.
religion.saints_pattern: the fravashi (the honest dead and just Shahs kept as fore-spirits) and the deified k'uhul-ajaw ancestors (the uchben), petitioned at the fire-altar, the carved stela, and the pyramid-tomb; 'the Arta-true [name]' (the righteous [name]).

religion.the_one: Asturna (< Aeternus / Axsatran Asturna; the Wise Lord Most High, upholder of Arta and source of the king's farnah-glory; Mayan substrate variant Aj Ternaj, the sky-most-high maker) - revered above His ministers when Lawful, set aside when Neutral

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon - the flower-war turned to dread, the blood-rite to terror - and names the Lawful powers and Asturna as the tyrant-gods of the Lie to be defied; Arta inverted.
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the One (Asturna) and the Lawful powers - Turvasa the just, Urlaspa of the sworn war, Naumana of the glyph-law, Riyata the merciful - upholds ARTA (Truth) and names the Chaotic powers the hosts of DRAUGA the Lie (Marakhsha / Marakab, demonized), warded; the paridaida-garden and the witz-altar are tended as the flowering rite of right-order
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent - somewhat honored, somewhat feared; foregrounds the fravashi (the honored fore-spirits) and the uchben (the ancestral k'uhul-ajaw dead), the day-lords and the local k'uh-spirits, the great powers invoked at the paridak'uh-garden and the atawitza-pyramid situationally

titles._tiers_note: Old-Persian ladder, ascending, with the Mayan substrate co-titles beneath. Vispati (clan-lord of a vis) barony; Marzapana (march-warden) march; Framatar (appointed governor) county over a Parada; Xshacapavan (SATRAP) duchy over a satrapy; Vispuhra (prince of the blood) principality over a Dahyu; Xshayathiya (king) kingdom - displayed as 'Shah' (the approved foreign term) over a Xshacam; Xshayathiya Xshayathiyanam (King of Kings) empire over the Vispa-Dahyu, all the lands. The conquered jungle-cities keep their Mayan k'uhul-ajaw (holy lord), sajal (subordinate governor), and batab' (local chief) beneath the Persian crown. The magu-magi tend the fire-and-flower altar, the ah-k'in keep the glyph-codex and the Long-Count, standing outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Old-Persian and Maya registers (allowed); display titles are English save the kingdom-tier 'Shah'.
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH, save the kingdom-tier display 'Shah' (an approved commonly-known foreign term set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (an Old-Persian satrapal rose-court over the Mayan pyramid city-states: the Xshayathiya/Shah and his vispuhra-kin at the crown tending the paridaida, the xshacapavan-satraps over the purakah garden-cities, the vispati clan-lords sworn to the court; the k'uhul-ajaw holy-lords and the ah-k'in glyph-priesthood of the witz endure and serve beneath)
titles.heir: Mathishta (the greatest; crown prince) / Baah-ch'ok (the head-youth, the heir)
